title: make build-go names a fork's images codesweep-ai
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach installs (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 9)

evidence.verified: In a scratch clone at 3b3e213 whose origin is `git@github.com-fork:forker/sandbox.git`, `make build-go` built a bin/cs-sandbox whose `version --images` names ghcr.io/forker/sandbox and localhost/forker/sandbox. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 3b3e213, once the nested sandbox smoke job was run again: its microVM had stopped answering.

resolution: The owner is read from origin with a pattern that takes an SSH host alias, as record-build.sh already did. A fork's build now names its images after the fork's owner.
details: `Makefile's IMAGE_OWNER` reads the owner from origin with `[@/]github\.com[:/]`, which needs a `:` or `/` right after `github.com`. An SSH host alias such as `git@github.com-fork:forker/sandbox.git`, which a fork's clones use, does not match. The build then falls back to `codesweep-ai`, so a fork's binary names its images under this project's name.
